findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_game, get_game_history, get_player_complaints, get_tag_trends, get_viral_videos, get_market_overview · Private data: find_emerging_games, get_game, list_niches, find_opportunities, analyze_niche, get_gap_analysis, track_my_game, get_trending_games, compare_games · Public sink: find_emerging_games, list_niches, find_opportunities, analyze_niche, get_tag_trends, get_viral_videos, get_trending_games, get_market_overview · Destructive: analyze_niche, get_player_complaints.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_game, get_game_history, get_player_complaints, get_tag_trends, get_viral_videos, get_market_overview · Private data: find_emerging_games, get_game, list_niches, find_opportunities, analyze_niche, get_gap_analysis, track_my_game, get_trending_games, compare_games · Public sink: find_emerging_games, list_niches, find_opportunities, analyze_niche, get_tag_trends, get_viral_videos, get_trending_games, get_market_overview · Destructive: analyze_niche, get_player_complaints

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_game_history" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
